# bootstrap-npm-repo — operator notes

## When

Immediately after GitHub “Use this template” (or equivalent) for an npm shared-library package under `winccoa-tools-pack`.

## Minimal command sequence (PowerShell)

Adjust repo name and remote as needed. Run from the new clone.

```powershell
# After setup-repo has set develop as default and clone tracks origin
gh workflow run auto-approve-owner-prs.yml
gh run list --workflow=auto-approve-owner-prs.yml --limit 3
gh label list --limit 100 | Select-String -Pattern "merge-in"

npm ci
npm run style-fix
npm test
```

## Org label membership

If catalog labels are missing:

1. Add `winccoa-tools-pack/<repo>` to `winccoa-tools-pack/.github` `repos.txt` (PR there).
2. Run **Run single-target label sync** with `target-repo: winccoa-tools-pack/<repo>`.

## Do not skip

- First dispatch of **Auto-approve owner PRs** (countdown labels).
- `npm run style-fix` before the first real PR.

## See also

- `SKILL.md` in this folder for the full ordered checklist.
